**1 — Scene:** A tray meal with roast chicken, cooked zucchini in tomato sauce, and a Greek-style salad. I include the bottled brown drink, provisionally identified as milky coffee. I exclude the separate noodle plate at the left edge and the water.

**2 — Vessels:** Chicken and vegetable side plates: approximately **20 cm diameter**, each **314 cm²**. Salad bowl: approximately **18 cm diameter**, **254 cm²**. For the drink, an approximately 5 cm internal diameter gives a **20 cm²** cross-section.

**3–7 — Items, coverage, volume, weight, and energy:** Percentages refer to each item's own vessel. Volume is the outer-envelope volume; density is the only adjustment for gaps.

| Item | Area coverage | Area × height = volume | Density → weight | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked zucchini/vegetables | 45% | 141 × 1.2 = 169 ml | 0.65 → 110 g | 50 | 55 |
| Tomato-based sauce | 15% | 47 × 0.4 = 19 ml | 1.0 → 19 g | 70 | 13 |
| Roast chicken meat | 40% | 126 × 1.4 = 176 ml | 0.95 → 167 g | 190 | 317 |
| Visible chicken skin | 5% | 16 × 0.3 = 5 ml | 0.95 → 5 g | 450 | 23 |
| Salad tomatoes | 22% | 56 × 2.0 = 112 ml | 0.6 → 67 g | 18 | 12 |

**Coverage check:** Vegetables and sauce cover about **60%** of their plate; chicken and skin **45%**; salad components **55%** of the bowl's projected area.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **456 g and 606 kcal of food**, or **636 g and 714 kcal including the drink**, is plausible for these visible portions. The drink's identity and sweetness are particularly uncertain.
